What it does: Aim gives them nothing, and the "target moved" penalty on their shots is **-2 dice** instead of -1: with one eye they cannot judge a moving target. But the good eye is sharp up close: **+1 die** on shots at a target within 6 inches
Move **halved** (rounded up), **-1 die on Grit tests to climb or jump**, and Press cannot push them (they are planted). The med-assistant said the leg was optional
Hands -1 until a robo-arm takes its place
Their skin is raw: blasts and fire are read one band **higher** against them
When an ally within 3 inches goes down, they hit the dirt: **prone**
The plate picks up voices. They may Ask the voice of any voiced item within 3 inches, an enemy's included; an enemy's item answers with that crew's voice
